question: If the area of an equilateral triangle is 16√3 sq cm, then the length of each side of the triangle is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an **equilateral triangle**, the relationship between **Area** and **side (a)** is: Area = (√3/4) × a².

Given Area = 16√3, we have 16√3 = (√3/4) × a².

Eliminate √3 from both sides: 16 = a²/4 ⇒ a² = 64.

Taking square root: a = 8 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf342228ac6e344842218e10689b365cbee18e17920bd12577a13687ad5d1dc0.png] 

**Given:**

Area of **equilateral triangle** = 16√3 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area = (√3/4) × (side)²

**Calculations:**

⇒ 16√3 = (√3/4) × a²

⇒ 16 = a² / 4

⇒ a² = 16 × 4

⇒ a² = 64

⇒ a = √64

⇒ a = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Height of Equilateral Triangle

The altitude or height (h) of an equilateral triangle is given by h = (√3/2) × a.

Perimeter of Equilateral Triangle

Since all three sides are equal, the perimeter (P) = 3 × a.

Inradius and Circumradius

Inradius (r) = a / (2√3) and Circumradius (R) = a / √3. Note that R = 2r.</p
